question: Sink in lifesim-d5f.61 (furnish against walls). Criterion 1 says a sink must touch a wall. But the game has no sink object, and the bead lists "new furniture models" as out of scope. Everything else is done or planned: the bed, sofa, fridge, stove, toilet and shower are against walls, two or more are in corners, and a reach test covers them. The review keeps rejecting the work over the missing sink. Options: (A) Defer the sink to a follow-up bead (add a sink, place it, run the reach test on it). Costs nothing now; criterion 1 is met without the sink. (B) Add a minimal sink object now: a content entry with front use slots, drawn in the client with a stand-in shape, placed against a wall and reach-tested. Costs a bit more work in this bead and a placeholder look until real art exists. I recommend A, because the bead itself rules out new furniture.

options.label: Defer the sink
options.answer: Defer the sink: criterion 1 is met without it in this bead. File the follow-up bead to add a sink object, place it against a wall in the furnished flat and the evening-alone fixture, and run the reach test on it.
options.note: No extra work; criterion 1 is met without the sink, and a follow-up bead adds it

options.label: Add a stand-in sink now
options.answer: Add a minimal sink object now: a content entry with front use slots, drawn with a stand-in shape in the client (no new model). Place it against a wall in both layouts and cover it in FurnitureReachTests and the Unity reach test.
options.note: More work in this bead; the sink looks like a placeholder until real art exists

title: Furnish against walls and in corners; every object stays reachable and usable
